title: PPROM Registry (Preterm Premature Rupture of Membranes)
official: Patient Registry for Women Diagnosed With Preterm Premature Rupture of Membranes or PPROM During Pregnancy
summary: Preterm Premature Rupture of Membranes (PPROM) before 37 weeks of pregnancy is responsible for 40% of preterm births in the United States. The PPROM Registry aims to identify possible causes of PPROM, evaluate trends in expectant management, measure maternal and fetal care, and to review short term and long term outcomes of affected pregnancies and births.
conditions: Preterm Premature Rupture of the Membranes

interventions.name: There is no intervention associated with this study.

criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Women diagnosed with Preterm Premature Rupture of Membranes (PPROM) prior to 37 weeks of pregnancy

Exclusion Criteria:

* Those without a clinical diagnosis or confirmation of PPROM in pregnancy
* Diagnosis of PROM beyond 37 weeks of pregnancy
